Real estate fund co-launched by Nuvama, Cushman & Wakefield closes at ₹4,000 crore

A joint venture between Nuvama and Cushman & Wakefield has successfully closed its first real estate fund at ₹4,000 crore. The fund, which focuses on office properties, exceeded its initial target by 33%. This achievement was driven by strong demand from domestic investors, and the venture is now preparing for a second fund.
